Unknownschema returns empty helper-errors; outer supported-provider-schema gate must refuse it. No full pipeline bypass inferred from helper alone.

Command orchestration captures provider/adapter revisions before/after, blocks self-inventory output, reruns provider for in-target stabilization and compares snapshots. These calls depend on API implementation not reviewed here; static orchestration is not end-to-end evidence freshness proof.
